name: featured-app
description: Featured App: screen, webcam and audio recording, plus silent printing to this machine's printers.
author: Featured App

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.build:win: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.cjs win-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.build:mac: node scripts/build-native-mac.cjs --force && node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.cjs mac-arm64 && node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.cjs mac-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:mac:local: node scripts/build-native-mac.cjs --force && node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.cjs mac-arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false
scripts.build:linux: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.cjs linux-x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64
